{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
name: PR Checks

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
      - release/*
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
      - release/*

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  LC_ALL: C.UTF-8
  GRADLE_CACHE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.GRADLE_CACHE_USERNAME }}
  GRADLE_CACHE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.GRADLE_CACHE_PASSWORD }}
  CG_EXEC: ionice -c 2 -n 2 nice -n 19

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: hiero-client-sdk-linux-medium
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@1d88384fd173af6ecb012dfd0264a306b711241a # v2.22.4
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: "0"

      - name: Setup NodeJS
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@77dd5b2ce225ea11469928ac317850245a74ae78 # v6.2.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21.0.6"

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@8da46b539cd8fe6ab27ca75128919a18d757604c # v6.4.1
        with:
          cache-read-only: false

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

      - name: Build SDK & Javadoc
        id: gradle-build
        run: ./gradlew assemble

  test:
    name: Unit and Integration Tests
    runs-on: hiero-client-sdk-linux-medium
    needs:
      - build
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@1d88384fd173af6ecb012dfd0264a306b711241a # v2.22.4
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # Shallow clones should be disabled for a better relevancy of analysis

      - name: Setup NodeJS
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@77dd5b2ce225ea11469928ac317850245a74ae78 # v6.2.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21.0.6"

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@8da46b539cd8fe6ab27ca75128919a18d757604c # v6.4.1

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

      - name: Prepare Hiero Solo
        id: solo
        uses: hiero-ledger/hiero-solo-action@dd84e95ece32d42071c945214571099ffbed9cf2 # v0.27.0
        with:
          installMirrorNode: true
          soloVersion: v0.91.0
          mirrorNodeVersion: v0.153.0
          hieroVersion: v0.73.0

      - name: Build SDK
        run: ./gradlew assemble

      - name: Code Quality Checks
        run: ./gradlew qualityCheck :examples:qualityCheck --continue

      - name: Run Unit and Integration Tests
        env:
          OPERATOR_KEY: "302e020100300506032b65700422042091132178e72057a1d7528025956fe39b0b847f200ab59b2fdd367017f3087137"
          OPERATOR_ID: "0.0.2"
          HEDERA_NETWORK: "localhost"
        run: |
          ./gradlew \
            -POPERATOR_ID=$OPERATOR_ID \
            -POPERATOR_KEY=$OPERATOR_KEY \
            -PHEDERA_NETWORK=$HEDERA_NETWORK \
            -PskipNodeUpdateTest=true \
            test \
            testIntegration \
            --rerun-tasks

            ./gradlew \
            -POPERATOR_ID=$OPERATOR_ID \
            -POPERATOR_KEY=$OPERATOR_KEY \
            -PHEDERA_NETWORK=$HEDERA_NETWORK \
            -PskipNodeUpdateTest=true \
            :aggregation:testCodeCoverageReport \
            --rerun-tasks

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]') }}
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@303a32d7a59b442fa8d48b6a1cc6825c09c847a5 # v7.1.1
        with:
          files: gradle/aggregation/build/reports/jacoco/testCodeCoverageReport/testCodeCoverageReport.xml

  test-dab:
    name: Test Dynamic Addressbook
    runs-on: hiero-client-sdk-linux-medium
    needs:
      - build
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@1d88384fd173af6ecb012dfd0264a306b711241a # v2.22.4
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup NodeJS
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@77dd5b2ce225ea11469928ac317850245a74ae78 # v6.2.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21.0.6"

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@8da46b539cd8fe6ab27ca75128919a18d757604c # v6.4.1

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

      - name: Prepare Hiero Solo (DUAL MODE)
        id: solo
        uses: hiero-ledger/hiero-solo-action@dd84e95ece32d42071c945214571099ffbed9cf2 # v0.27.0
        with:
          installMirrorNode: true
          soloVersion: v0.91.0
          dualMode: true
          hieroVersion: v0.73.0
          mirrorNodeVersion: v0.153.0

      - name: Build SDK
        run: ./gradlew assemble

      - name: Run tests
        env:
          OPERATOR_KEY: "302e020100300506032b65700422042091132178e72057a1d7528025956fe39b0b847f200ab59b2fdd367017f3087137"
          OPERATOR_ID: "0.0.2"
          HEDERA_NETWORK: "localhost"
        run: |
          ./gradlew \
            -POPERATOR_ID=$OPERATOR_ID \
            -POPERATOR_KEY=$OPERATOR_KEY \
            -PHEDERA_NETWORK=$HEDERA_NETWORK \
            testIntegration \
            --tests "*NodeUpdateTransactionIntegrationTest" \
            --rerun-tasks

  run-examples:
    name: Run Examples
    runs-on: hiero-client-sdk-linux-medium
    needs:
      - build
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@1d88384fd173af6ecb012dfd0264a306b711241a # v2.22.4
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup NodeJS
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@77dd5b2ce225ea11469928ac317850245a74ae78 # v6.2.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21.0.6"

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: step-security/setup-android@6be8e374894861aef6b01c150cf6a9822297e319 # v4.0.4
        with:
          packages: platform-tools

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@8da46b539cd8fe6ab27ca75128919a18d757604c # v6.4.1

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

      - name: Prepare Hiero Solo
        id: solo
        uses: hiero-ledger/hiero-solo-action@dd84e95ece32d42071c945214571099ffbed9cf2 # v0.27.0
        with:
          installMirrorNode: true
          soloVersion: v0.91.0
          mirrorNodeVersion: v0.153.0
          hieroVersion: v0.73.0

      - name: Build SDK
        run: ./gradlew assemble

      - name: Build Android Example
        run: ./gradlew -p example-android assemble

      - name: Prepare .env for Examples
        run: |
          echo "OPERATOR_KEY=302e020100300506032b65700422042091132178e72057a1d7528025956fe39b0b847f200ab59b2fdd367017f3087137" > examples/.env
          echo "OPERATOR_ID=0.0.2" >> examples/.env
          echo "HEDERA_NETWORK=localhost" >> examples/.env

      - name: Run Examples
        run: ./gradlew :examples:runAllExamples

  test-tck:
    name: TCK Tests
    runs-on: hiero-client-sdk-linux-medium
    needs:
      - build
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@1d88384fd173af6ecb012dfd0264a306b711241a # v2.22.4
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # Shallow clones should be disabled for a better relevancy of analysis

      - name: Setup NodeJS
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@77dd5b2ce225ea11469928ac317850245a74ae78 # v6.2.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21.0.6"

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@8da46b539cd8fe6ab27ca75128919a18d757604c # v6.4.1

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

      - name: Build TCK
        run: ./gradlew assemble

      - name: Run TCK Unit Tests
        run: ./gradlew :tck:test

  tck-compatibility:
    name: TCK Compatibility
    runs-on: hiero-client-sdk-linux-medium
    needs:
      - build
      - test
      - test-tck
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@1d88384fd173af6ecb012dfd0264a306b711241a # v2.22.4
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # Shallow clones should be disabled for a better relevancy of analysis

      - name: Setup NodeJS
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@77dd5b2ce225ea11469928ac317850245a74ae78 # v6.2.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21.0.6"

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@8da46b539cd8fe6ab27ca75128919a18d757604c # v6.4.1

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

      - name: Build and Start TCK Server
        id: tck-server
        run: |
          ./gradlew assemble
          nohup ./gradlew tck:bootRun > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/tck-server.log" 2>&1 &
          echo "pid=$!" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Prepare Hiero Solo
        id: solo
        uses: hiero-ledger/hiero-solo-action@dd84e95ece32d42071c945214571099ffbed9cf2 # v0.27.0
        with:
          installMirrorNode: true
          soloVersion: v0.91.0
          hieroVersion: v0.73.0
          mirrorNodeVersion: v0.153.0

      - name: Run TCK Compatibility
        uses: hiero-ledger/hiero-sdk-tck@c9e7169888d86be4793cde5932ce57d9450a9761 # v0.14.0
        with:
          json-rpc-server-url: http://127.0.0.1:8544
          node-ip: 127.0.0.1:35211
          mirror-node-rest-url: http://127.0.0.1:38081
          artifact-name: tck-compatibility

      - name: Upload TCK Server Log
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: tck-server-log
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/tck-server.log
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Stop TCK Server
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: |
          if kill "${{ steps.tck-server.outputs.pid }}" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "TCK server stopped"
          else
            echo "TCK server already stopped"
          fi

  "rationale": "The workflow uses Gradle in every job but relies solely on the built-in caching of `gradle/actions/setup-gradle`. Evidence from experiment `experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200` (pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) shows that adding an explicit `actions/cache` step for `~/.gradle/caches` with a key based on Gradle build files and wrapper properties reduced median elapsed time by ~20% on a similar Gradle workflow. The preconditions are met: the repository has Gradle build files (`**/*.gradle*`) and a wrapper (`gradle-wrapper.properties`), and repeated dependency fetching occurs across six jobs. The contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists" is mitigated because the experiment's baseline already used `setup-gradle` and still benefited from the additional cache step. Adding the cache step in each job after `Setup Gradle` preserves all existing build and test coverage while providing a measurable speedup.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
